lines.zh: 四条腿像柱子，一步挪了很远。
lines.en: Four legs like pillars; one step covers a lot.

lines.zh: 地面在我脚下轻轻发颤。
lines.en: The ground trembles faintly under me.

lines.zh: 我脖子伸得高，看得也远。
lines.en: My neck reaches high and sees far.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走过平原，草都倒伏。
lines.en: I cross the plain slowly and the grass lies flat.

lines.zh: 尾巴很长，走起来要甩稳。
lines.en: My tail is long; I swing it to balance.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩下，泥里留个坑。
lines.en: One step leaves a pit in the mud.

lines.zh: 我不急，走快了会踩坏东西。
lines.en: No hurry; at speed I'd trample things.

lines.zh: 我绕过一群吃草的小兽。
lines.en: I go around a herd of small grazers.

lines.zh: 我沿着河谷走，水声在旁边。
lines.en: I walk the river valley with the water beside me.

lines.zh: 我把脖子压下来，够低处的叶。
lines.en: I lower my neck to reach the low leaves.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方像被压平了。
lines.en: What I walk over ends up flattened.

lines.zh: 我踩空半步，赶紧挪开重心。
lines.en: I miss half a step and shift my weight fast.

lines.zh: 我的影子有半片林子那么长。
lines.en: My shadow is half a wood long.

lines.zh: 我一步一步往高处的林子去。
lines.en: I work my way toward the higher trees.
I stand while my neck turns slowly.
I chew a great mouthful of leaves.
I look up; the treetops are still below me.

lines.zh: 我把头低到地上闻了闻。
lines.en: I lower my head to the ground and sniff.
There's a sound in my belly.
I swing my tail slowly.

lines.zh: 我背上那道旧伤被晒暖了。
lines.en: The old scar on my back warms in the sun.

lines.zh: 我把头垂下来，闻了闻草。
lines.en: I lower my head and sniff the grass.
There's a herd of small beasts at my feet.

lines.zh: 我把长脖子盘下来，歇一歇。
lines.en: I curl my long neck down and rest.

lines.zh: 风把我的影子吹得很晃。
lines.en: The wind makes my shadow waver.
I shift onto another leg.
Birds fly past my back.
I'm waiting for the sun to drop behind the trees.
You come up to my ankle.

lines.zh: 我得把脖子弯下来才看得清你。
lines.en: I have to bend my neck down to see you clearly.
One of my steps would be enough.

lines.zh: 你站在我影子里，很凉快吧。
lines.en: You're standing in my shadow — cool, isn't it?
I tilt my head slowly.
You carry very little smell.
I'm not intending to step on you.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，你就看不见了。
lines.en: When I lift my head, you disappear from view.

lines.zh: 你的声音太小，我只听见风。
lines.en: Your voice is too small; I only hear the wind.

lines.zh: 我把路让出来，你过去吧。
lines.en: I step aside; go on past.
You look up; I have to move my neck.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢脚底下有东西。
lines.en: I don't like things under my feet.

lines.zh: 我把脖子缩回来，护住胸口。
lines.en: I pull my neck back to guard my chest.

lines.zh: 我的前腿一软，差点跪下。
lines.en: My foreleg gives and I nearly kneel.
I take a step back and the ground shakes.
Blood runs down my hide.
I draw my neck in a little.

lines.zh: 我尾巴扫过灌木，叶子落了一地。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the brush and leaves rain down.
I lower my head to find the wound.
It hurts, but I'm standing.

lines.zh: 我不擅长打，我擅长撑着。
lines.en: I'm no fighter; I'm good at enduring.

lines.zh: 我疼得跺了一下脚，地动了。
lines.en: I stamp once in pain and the ground moves.
The smell of leaves is up high.
Hold them higher.
I bend my neck down to reach.

lines.zh: 你把叶子举高些，我够得着。
lines.en: Hold the leaves higher, within my reach.
I move over carefully.
I don't eat people; I eat leaves.
Stand back; I don't want to step on you.

lines.zh: 这丛正好，我低头就够到。
lines.en: This clump is just right at head-height.
I have to chew slowly; my teeth aren't much use.

lines.zh: 这一口连枝都咬下来了。
lines.en: That bite took the branch with it.
I pull my foot back without putting it down.

lines.zh: 你被我一碰就偏了很远。
lines.en: One touch from me and you're far off course.
I give half a step and the ground moves.
Sorry — my footprint is too wide.

lines.zh: 我腿一让，你整个人歪过去。
lines.en: I shift my leg and you stumble right past it.
I've turned aside as much as I can.

lines.zh: 这一下我差点失去平衡。
lines.en: That nearly cost me my balance.

lines.zh: 我低头看看你有没有事。
lines.en: I lower my head to check on you.
You've left a pit in the ground.

lines.zh: 我们两个在这个坡上太挤。
lines.en: We're too crowded on this slope.

lines.zh: 她从林子里慢慢走出来。
lines.en: She comes slowly out of the trees.
Our necks come together.
I touch her shoulder with my head.

lines.zh: 两副身体把地面压出印子。
lines.en: Our bodies press marks into the ground.

lines.zh: 这一片林子够我们吃很久。
lines.en: This wood will feed us a long while.
We leave our prints overlapping.
She moves slowly; I'm not fast either.

lines.zh: 我把脖子弯过去，碰她的颈。
lines.en: I bend my neck over and touch hers.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴和她的错在一起。
lines.en: My tail crosses hers.
We keep watch the same way.
I pick up a branch and crunch it.

lines.zh: 这一点对我来说太小了。
lines.en: That's tiny for me.
I lower my head and curl it up with my tongue.
I stepped it into the mud.

lines.zh: 我用舌头把那根枝条卷起来。
lines.en: I curl my tongue around the branch.
I eat it; no taste.

lines.zh: 我用前脚把那东西拨开。
lines.en: I nudge the thing aside with a forefoot.
This leaf still has dew on it.
My teeth don't go in for that.
I swallow branch and leaf together.

lines.zh: 那群小兽朝我这边来了。
lines.en: That herd of small beasts is coming my way.

lines.zh: 我把头转过去，看向那片林子。
lines.en: I turn my head toward the stand of trees.
I lower my body as if to charge.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌已经摆好位置。
lines.en: My foot is already placed.
They're panicking under me.
I swing my tail across.
I don't want to hurt them.
I only want to hold this ground.

lines.zh: 我朝那边迈出半步，地就沉了。
lines.en: Half a step that way and the ground gives.
The tremor alone should do it.
One more step forward.
They've started to pull back.
I lift a forefoot and hold it.
I don't actually need to charge.
I turn slowly, half a circle.

lines.zh: 它们往哪边，我就往哪边。
lines.en: Wherever they go, I go.

lines.zh: 我把脖子压低，像一道墙。
lines.en: I lower my neck like a wall.
Every step is slow but sure.
I'm waiting for them to scatter.

lines.zh: 我的影子把它们盖住了。
lines.en: My shadow covers them.

lines.zh: 它们撞在我腿上，弹回去。
lines.en: They hit my leg and bounce off.
I haven't sped up at all.
This grass is mine to eat.
They've backed to the river.
I've opened the way.
They're quick — quicker than me.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，等你自己走开。
lines.en: I stand still and wait for you to leave on your own.
I stand and watch them go.

lines.zh: 我站着，等它们自己走远。
lines.en: I stand and wait for them to drift off.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩下去，地面裂了。
lines.en: My foot comes down and the ground splits.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过去，把它们扫翻。
lines.en: My tail sweeps and knocks them flat.
I ram with my flank.

lines.zh: 这一下我自己都震到了。
lines.en: That one shook even me.
I drive them toward the river.
My foot is resting on something.
I lift my foot quickly.
They scatter in every direction.
I call out, long and drawn.
I don't follow; I just stand.
A deep pit is left in the ground.

lines.zh: 这一下我不该用那么大力。
lines.en: I shouldn't have used that much force.

lines.zh: 我的影子先落在它们身上。
lines.en: My shadow reached them first.
They scrambled away.

lines.zh: 我先站了起来，树都在晃。
lines.en: I rise, and the trees shake.

lines.zh: 第一眼看到的是一片林子，很小。
lines.en: The first sight is a wood — very small.

lines.zh: 我的四条腿撑住巨大的身体。
lines.en: Four legs take up my huge weight.
I extend my neck slowly.
The ground sinks a little.
I call and the birds all take off.
I don't know the way; I'll follow the sun.
My tail sweeps a patch of grass flat.
Something is running by my feet.
I look down and it darts away.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了半片空地。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the clearing.
I try a step; it lands heavy.
The far trees are much shorter than me.
I raise my head to look for food.

lines.zh: 嘴里还留着蛋壳的味道。
lines.en: The taste of eggshell is still in my mouth.
I start toward the wood.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，先吃了一口。
lines.en: I lower my head and take a first bite.

lines.zh: 我的脚下踩着一片湿草。
lines.en: There's wet grass under my feet.

lines.zh: 皮上的火烧得我直跺脚。
lines.en: Fire on my hide makes me stamp.

lines.zh: 我砸到地上，整片地都震了。
lines.en: I hit the ground and the whole earth shakes.

lines.zh: 水淹到我的嘴，我抬不起头。
lines.en: Water reaches my mouth and I can't lift my head.

lines.zh: 冲击掀在我腿上，我差点倒下。
lines.en: The blast hits my leg and I nearly fall.
The arrowhead stops just inside my hide.

lines.zh: 那股力量顺着我的脊骨往上爬。
lines.en: That force crawls up my spine.

lines.zh: 吃得不够，我走路都发空。
lines.en: Not enough food; my steps feel hollow.

lines.zh: 雷打在背上，我腿都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and numbs my legs.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我整个坠下去。
lines.en: The ground's gone and I drop whole.
